art_direction.background_logic: deep indigo holds a sequence of paper, orange, lime and blue signal fields
art_direction.behance_viewing_arc: entry window, release system, object translation, public room, curatorial power, runway gap, future watch

closing_palette.rationale: Night indigo keeps the radar deliberately open; orange marks the next verified movement without pretending it has arrived.

art_direction.core_visual_action: a route changes from clock to object to room to city without pretending the signals are one trend
art_direction.cover_composition: a large moving-entry title beside a route board connecting drop, release, object, gallery and runway
art_direction.desktop_interaction_mechanic: a sticky issue index remains visible on desktop; the mobile details panel opens a no-JS index without hiding the article
art_direction.dominant_mood: a fluorescent release board that opens into a night map
art_direction.image_behavior: one original local SVG information figure per story; no third-party editorial photography
art_direction.mobbin_usability_constraint: 44px links, scroll-margin for anchored headings, readable source labels, no nested scrolling in the redesigned historical reader
art_direction.mobile_translation: single-column figures, two-column index disclosure, shorter display headings, captions retained below every figure
art_direction.page_density_and_tempo: dense cover, two release-led majors, tactile signals, explicit runway gap, forward-looking watches, quiet exit
art_direction.palette_logic: indigo for the clock, paper for verification, orange for movement, lime for confirmed windows, blue for open questions
art_direction.quiet_ending: an intentionally unfilled runway radar and one sentence waiting for the next verified drop
art_direction.type_scale_logic: compressed display titles for entry points, readable 18px body copy, monospaced timestamps and source labels

editorial_position: The week's verified signals are not one trend; they are changes in the time, place, and distance through which culture is entered.
limitations: This is a non-production Preview issue; manifest status and QA fields are reporting only.
Research and content were refreshed on 2026-08-24 after the canonical 06:00–08:30 production refresh window; the issue is intentionally not production-eligible.

Five source-image previews are displayed from publisher-hosted URLs with a click-through to the source; these are Preview-only and are not rights-cleared for production. The remaining three visuals are original local SVG information diagrams.
Supreme and Stüssy release claims are limited to the official page states and release windows observed; inventory, sales and cultural impact are not inferred.
The runway radar explicitly records a missing qualifying luxury-house event rather than filling the slot with stale or unverified material.
